extends Node2D
## One board piece. Display only: it never decides anything.
##
## The node position is the centre of the base disc. set_state() swaps ONE static texture:
##   res://assets/art/archer_<state>.png        (player)
##   res://assets/art/archer_<state>_enemy.png  (enemy; falls back to the player image tinted red)
## Without any image it draws a clearly labelled code placeholder.

const TARGET_HEIGHT: float = 80.0 ## on-screen height of the piece (idle image scaled to this)
const BASE_FROM_BOTTOM: float = 6.0 ## base-disc centre above the image's bottom edge, in screen px
const HOP_HEIGHT: float = 16.0
const HURT_TIME: float = 0.5
const RECOVER_TIME: float = 0.4
const ART_DIR: String = "res://assets/art/"
const STATES: Array[String] = ["idle", "draw", "hurt", "defeat", "win", "hop", "recover"]
const OPTIONAL_FALLBACK: Dictionary = {"hop": "idle", "recover": "idle"}
const ENEMY_TINT: Color = Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.5)
## A5 "exposed" tint (CHANGE-BRIEF §2). Each piece's sprite owns its own ShaderMaterial (R6).
const ExposedTintShader: Shader = preload("res://shaders/exposed_tint.gdshader")

const COL_INK: Color = Color("#1B1410")
const COL_BIRCH: Color = Color("#E2B887")
const COL_PLAYER: Color = Color("#1F6F78")
const COL_ENEMY: Color = Color("#B23A2E")
const COL_HOOD: Color = Color("#24323F")
const COL_WALNUT: Color = Color("#5A3A22")

static var _tex_cache: Dictionary = {}

var unit_id: String = ""
var team: String = "player"
var facing: int = 1
var state: String = "idle"
var cell: Vector2i = Vector2i.ZERO
var texture_source: String = "placeholder" ## "player" | "enemy" | "player_tinted" | "placeholder"

var _sprite: Sprite2D
var _lift: float = 0.0
var _hopping: bool = false
var _hop_from: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var _hop_to: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var _hop_t: float = 0.0
var _hop_dur: float = 0.25
var _hurt_left: float = 0.0
var _recover_left: float = 0.0


func setup(id: String, team_name: String, start_facing: int, start_cell: Vector2i) -> void:
	unit_id = id
	team = team_name
	facing = start_facing
	cell = start_cell
	if _sprite == null:
		_sprite = Sprite2D.new()
		_sprite.centered = true
		var mat: ShaderMaterial = ShaderMaterial.new() # a new one per sprite, never shared (R6)
		mat.shader = ExposedTintShader
		mat.set_shader_parameter("exposed_amount", 0.0)
		_sprite.material = mat
		add_child(_sprite)
	set_state("idle")


## Set only by the exposed driver (game/exposed_driver.gd), and only on the player archer.
func set_exposed_amount(v: float) -> void:
	var mat: ShaderMaterial = tint_material()
	if mat != null:
		mat.set_shader_parameter("exposed_amount", v)


func tint_material() -> ShaderMaterial:
	return _sprite.material as ShaderMaterial if _sprite != null else null


func set_facing(f: int) -> void:
	if f == 0 or f == facing:
		return
	facing = f
	_apply_visual()


func set_state(new_state: String) -> void:
	state = new_state
	if new_state != "hurt":
		_hurt_left = 0.0
	if new_state != "recover":
		_recover_left = 0.0
	_apply_visual()


func show_hurt() -> void:
	set_state("hurt")
	_hurt_left = HURT_TIME


func show_recover() -> void:
	if _find_texture("recover")[0] != null:
		set_state("recover")
		_recover_left = RECOVER_TIME
	else:
		set_state("idle")


func is_hopping() -> bool:
	return _hopping


func start_hop(from_pos: Vector2, to_pos: Vector2, duration: float) -> void:
	_hop_from = from_pos
	_hop_to = to_pos
	_hop_t = 0.0
	_hop_dur = maxf(duration, 0.001)
	_hopping = true
	position = from_pos
	if _find_texture("hop")[0] != null:
		set_state("hop")


func finish_hop() -> void:
	_hopping = false
	position = _hop_to
	_set_lift(0.0)
	if state == "hop":
		set_state("idle")


## Advanced by main with the (scaled) game clock, so pause stops it.
func tick(dt: float) -> void:
	if _hopping:
		_hop_t = minf(_hop_t + dt, _hop_dur)
		var k: float = _hop_t / _hop_dur
		position = _hop_from.lerp(_hop_to, k)
		_set_lift(HOP_HEIGHT * sin(PI * k))
	if _hurt_left > 0.0:
		_hurt_left -= dt
		if _hurt_left <= 0.0 and state == "hurt":
			set_state("idle")
	if _recover_left > 0.0:
		_recover_left -= dt
		if _recover_left <= 0.0 and state == "recover":
			set_state("idle")


func _set_lift(v: float) -> void:
	_lift = v
	_apply_visual()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- textures

## Returns [Texture2D or null, source, modulate].
func _find_texture(state_name: String) -> Array:
	var tex: Texture2D = null
	if team == "enemy":
		tex = _load_tex(ART_DIR + "archer_%s_enemy.png" % state_name)
		if tex != null:
			return [tex, "enemy", Color.WHITE]
		tex = _load_tex(ART_DIR + "archer_%s.png" % state_name)
		if tex != null:
			return [tex, "player_tinted", ENEMY_TINT]
	else:
		tex = _load_tex(ART_DIR + "archer_%s.png" % state_name)
		if tex != null:
			return [tex, "player", Color.WHITE]
	return [null, "placeholder", Color.WHITE]


static func _load_tex(path: String) -> Texture2D:
	if _tex_cache.has(path):
		return _tex_cache[path]
	var tex: Texture2D = null
	if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
		var res: Resource = load(path)
		if res is Texture2D:
			tex = res as Texture2D
	_tex_cache[path] = tex
	return tex


func _apply_visual() -> void:
	if _sprite == null:
		return
	var found: Array = _find_texture(state)
	if found[0] == null and OPTIONAL_FALLBACK.has(state):
		found = _find_texture(OPTIONAL_FALLBACK[state])
	var tex: Texture2D = found[0]
	texture_source = found[1]
	if tex == null:
		_sprite.visible = false
		queue_redraw()
		return
	# One scale for every pose, taken from the idle image, so all states share the same pixel size.
	var ref: Texture2D = _find_texture("idle")[0]
	if ref == null:
		ref = tex
	var s: float = TARGET_HEIGHT / maxf(1.0, float(ref.get_height()))
	_sprite.texture = tex
	_sprite.visible = true
	_sprite.modulate = found[2]
	_sprite.scale = Vector2(s, s)
	_sprite.flip_h = facing < 0
	_sprite.position = Vector2(0.0, -tex.get_height() * s * 0.5 + BASE_FROM_BOTTOM - _lift)
	queue_redraw()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- placeholder

func _draw() -> void:
	if _sprite != null and _sprite.visible:
		return
	var paint: Color = COL_PLAYER if team == "player" else COL_ENEMY
	var lean: float = 0.0
	match state:
		"hurt":
			lean = -0.32
		"defeat":
			lean = -1.45
	# Base disc stays on the board; the body leans/topples around it.
	draw_set_transform(Vector2(0.0, -_lift), 0.0, Vector2(facing, 1.0))
	_ellipse(Vector2.ZERO, Vector2(20.0, 6.0), COL_WALNUT)
	draw_set_transform(Vector2(0.0, -_lift - 4.0), lean * facing, Vector2(facing, 1.0))
	# quiver on the back
	draw_rect(Rect2(-19.0, -50.0, 7.0, 24.0), COL_WALNUT)
	draw_rect(Rect2(-19.0, -50.0, 7.0, 24.0), COL_INK, false, 2.0)
	# body
	draw_rect(Rect2(-12.0, -50.0, 24.0, 48.0), paint)
	draw_rect(Rect2(-12.0, -50.0, 24.0, 48.0), COL_INK, false, 2.5)
	# hood and ball head
	draw_circle(Vector2(-1.0, -60.0), 13.0, COL_HOOD)
	draw_circle(Vector2(2.0, -60.0), 9.5, COL_BIRCH)
	draw_arc(Vector2(-1.0, -60.0), 13.0, 0.0, TAU, 24, COL_INK, 2.0)
	draw_circle(Vector2(7.0, -61.0), 1.8, COL_INK)
	# bow
	match state:
		"draw":
			draw_arc(Vector2(10.0, -32.0), 22.0, -1.25, 1.25, 16, COL_WALNUT, 3.5)
			draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(16.5, -53.0), Vector2(-2.0, -32.0), Vector2(16.5, -11.0)]), COL_INK, 1.5)
		"win":
			draw_line(Vector2(6.0, -44.0), Vector2(18.0, -72.0), COL_INK, 3.0)
			draw_arc(Vector2(18.0, -78.0), 10.0, -2.6, 0.6, 12, COL_WALNUT, 3.0)
		_:
			draw_arc(Vector2(4.0, -32.0), 20.0, -1.2, 1.2, 16, COL_WALNUT, 3.5)
			draw_line(Vector2(11.2, -50.6), Vector2(11.2, -13.4), COL_INK, 1.2)
	# state label, unflipped, so the placeholder is obviously a placeholder
	draw_set_transform(Vector2(0.0, -_lift), 0.0, Vector2.ONE)
	var font: Font = ThemeDB.fallback_font
	var label: String = "[%s]" % state
	draw_rect(Rect2(-26.0, -96.0, 52.0, 13.0), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.7))
	draw_string(font, Vector2(-26.0, -86.0), label, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 52.0, 10, COL_INK)
	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2.ONE)


func _ellipse(center: Vector2, radii: Vector2, fill: Color) -> void:
	var pts: PackedVector2Array = PackedVector2Array()
	for i: int in 24:
		var a: float = TAU * float(i) / 24.0
		pts.append(center + Vector2(cos(a) * radii.x, sin(a) * radii.y))
	draw_colored_polygon(pts, fill)
	pts.append(pts[0])

4	; 60 fps: step 1/60, length 48 frames = 0.8 s, LOOP_NONE. Played by the rig's AnimationPlayer
5	; (root_node = Mount) in ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_MANUAL; nothing here is read by the game.

7	; One key per track at every phase boundary (time = frame / 60):
8	;   frame  0 -> 0.0        trigger, startup begins      (_cue_draw)
9	;   frame 12 -> 0.2        active opens, release        (_cue_arrow, DRAW_LEAD 0.2)
10	;   frame 33 -> 0.55       recovery opens, impact       (_cue_impact, + ARROW_TIME 0.35)
11	;   frame 40 -> 0.666667   bow drop begins              (recovery split, chosen by eye)
12	;   frame 48 -> 0.8        back to idle, clip ends      (_cue_attacker_idle, + ATTACK_RECOVER 0.25)
13	;
14	; Values in the art's own pixels and angles. The art faces right; in Godot 2D a positive rotation
15	; turns clockwise on screen, so "back" is -x / negative angle and "forward and down" is positive.
16	;   Rig:position             (0,0)  (0,0)   (-6,0)  (-6,0)  (0,0)     recoil 6 px backwards
17	;   Rig/Upper:rotation        0°    -4°     +2°     +2°      0°       lean back 4°, then 2° forward
18	;   Rig/Upper/Bow:rotation   +12°    0°      0°      0°     +20°      12° below level -> level -> tipped 20° forward/down
19	; (radians: 4° = 0.0698132, 2° = 0.0349066, 12° = 0.20944, 20° = 0.349066)
20	;
21	; Transition on each key (the segment from that key to the next; Godot ease() curve):
22	;   frame  0: 2.0   ease in, accelerating towards the release
23	;   frame 12: 0.5   ease out, fast at the release, slowing through the follow-through
24	;   frame 33: 1.0   hold (keys 33 and 40 have the same values, so nothing moves)
25	;   frame 40: -2.0  ease in-out (the bow drop)
26	;   frame 48: 1.0   last key, no segment after it

1	extends Node2D
2	## Lane Tactics asset slice: scene controller.
3	##
4	## Each step asks Rules for the result FIRST, then plays the returned event list back once
5	## (visuals + AudioDirector). Playback and sound never decide game state.
6	## Pause is implemented without get_tree().paused: the controller stops its own clock.
7	
8	const RulesScript = preload("res://game/rules.gd")
9	const PieceScript = preload("res://game/piece.gd")
10	const DrawLayerScript = preload("res://game/draw_layer.gd")
11	const AudioDirectorScript = preload("res://game/audio_director.gd")
12	
13	enum State { TITLE, PLAN_MOVE, PLAY_MOVES, PLAN_ATTACK, PLAY_ATTACKS, WON, LOST }
14	const STATE_NAMES: Array[String] = ["TITLE", "PLAN_MOVE", "PLAY_MOVES", "PLAN_ATTACK", "PLAY_ATTACKS", "WON", "LOST"]
15	const PHASE_LABELS: Array[String] = ["", "PLAN MOVE", "MOVES", "PLAN ATTACK", "COMBAT", "VICTORY", "DEFEAT"]
16	
17	const PLAYER_ID: String = "p1"
18	const VIEW: Vector2 = Vector2(1280, 720)

109	func _ready() -> void:
110		_ensure_actions()
111		rules = RulesScript.new()
112		audio = get_node_or_null("AudioDirector") as AudioDirectorScript
113		if audio == null:
114			audio = AudioDirectorScript.new()
115			audio.name = "AudioDirector"
116			add_child(audio)
117		_board_layer = _make_layer(_draw_board, 0)
118		_board_layer.texture_repeat = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_REPEAT_ENABLED
119		_pieces_root = Node2D.new()
120		_pieces_root.name = "Pieces"
121		_pieces_root.y_sort_enabled = true
122		_pieces_root.z_index = 1
123		add_child(_pieces_root)
124		_fx_layer = _make_layer(_draw_fx, 2)
125		_hud_layer = _make_layer(_draw_hud, 3)
126		_build_pieces()
127		state = State.TITLE
128		audio.new_session() # MUS-LOOP starts on the title and continues into play

130	
131	func _make_layer(fn: Callable, z: int) -> Node2D:
132		var n: Node2D = DrawLayerScript.new()
133		n.draw_fn = fn
134		n.z_index = z
135		add_child(n)
136		return n
137	
138	
139	static func _ensure_actions() -> void:
140		for action: String in ACTION_ORDER:
141			if InputMap.has_action(action):
142				continue
143			InputMap.add_action(action)
144			for code: int in ACTION_KEYS[action]:
145				var ev: InputEventKey = InputEventKey.new()
146				ev.physical_keycode = code as Key
147				InputMap.action_add_event(action, ev)
148	
149

151		return STATE_NAMES[state]
152	
153	
154	func selected_target() -> Variant:
155		if target_index >= 0 and target_index < targets.size():
156			return targets[target_index]
157		return null
158	
159	
160	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- clock
161	
162	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
163		var dt: float = delta * time_scale
164		audio.time_scale = time_scale
165		_time += delta
166		if not paused:
167			_clock += dt
168			_run_cues()
169			for p: PieceScript in pieces.values():
170				p.tick(dt)
171			_tick_fx(dt)
172			if _message_left > 0.0:
173				_message_left -= dt
174			if _card_lock > 0.0:
175				_card_lock -= dt
176		_board_layer.queue_redraw()
177		_fx_layer.queue_redraw()
178		_hud_layer.queue_redraw()
179	
180	
181	func _schedule(t: float, fn: Callable) -> void:
182		var i: int = _cues.size()
183		while i > 0 and float(_cues[i - 1]["t"]) > t:
184			i -= 1
185		_cues.insert(i, {"t": t, "fn": fn})
186	
187	
188	func _clear_cues() -> void:
189		_cues.clear()
190		_clock = 0.0
191	
192	
193	func _run_cues() -> void:
194		while not _cues.is_empty() and float(_cues[0]["t"]) <= _clock:
195			var c: Dictionary = _cues.pop_front()
196			(c["fn"] as Callable).call()
197	
198	
199	func _tick_fx(dt: float) -> void:
200		for f: Dictionary in _floaters:
201			f["t"] = float(f["t"]) + dt
202		_floaters = _floaters.filter(func(f: Dictionary) -> bool: return float(f["t"]) < FLOAT_TIME)
203		for a: Dictionary in _arrows:
204			a["t"] = float(a["t"]) + dt
205		_arrows = _arrows.filter(func(a: Dictionary) -> bool: return float(a["t"]) < ARROW_TIME)
206	
207	
208	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- input
209	
210	func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
211		if not (event is InputEventKey):
212			return
213		var k: InputEventKey = event as InputEventKey
214		if not k.pressed:
215			return
216		if k.is_echo():
217			ignored_echoes += 1 # held keys never act
218			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
219			return
220		var action: String = _action_for(k)
221		if action == "":
222			return
223		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
224		_handle_action(action, k)
225	
226	
227	func _action_for(event: InputEvent) -> String:
228		for action: String in ACTION_ORDER:
229			if event.is_action(action):
230				return action
231		return ""
232	
233	
234	func _handle_action(action: String, k: InputEventKey) -> void:
235		match action:
236			"lt_music":
237				audio.toggle_music_mute()
238				return
239			"lt_sfx":
240				audio.toggle_sfx_mute()
241				return
242			"lt_debug":
243				debug_footprints = not debug_footprints
244				return
245		if state == State.TITLE:
246			if action == "lt_confirm":
247				_start_play()
248			else:
249				ignored_inputs += 1
250			return
251		if action == "lt_pause":
252			if _in_play():
253				_set_paused(not paused)
254			elif show_results and (k.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE or k.physical_keycode == KEY_ESCAPE):
255				get_tree().quit()
256			else:
257				ignored_inputs += 1
258			return
259		if paused:
260			ignored_inputs += 1
261			return
262		if action == "lt_retry":
263			_restart(true)
264			return
265		match state:
266			State.PLAN_MOVE:
267				if DIRS.has(action):
268					_adjust_move(DIRS[action])
269				elif action == "lt_confirm":
270					_confirm_move(planned_offset)
271				elif action == "lt_stay":
272					_confirm_move(Vector2i.ZERO)
273			State.PLAN_ATTACK:
274				if action == "lt_left" or action == "lt_up":
275					_cycle_target(-1)
276				elif action == "lt_right" or action == "lt_down":
277					_cycle_target(1)
278				elif action == "lt_confirm":
279					_confirm_attack(selected_target())
280				elif action == "lt_stay":
281					_confirm_attack(null)
282			State.WON, State.LOST:
283				if action != "lt_confirm" or _card_lock > 0.0:
284					ignored_inputs += 1
285				elif not show_results:
286					show_results = true
287				else:
288					_restart(false)
289			_:
290				ignored_inputs += 1 # playback: gameplay input is ignored
291	
292	
293	func _in_play() -> bool:
294		return state in [State.PLAN_MOVE, State.PLAY_MOVES, State.PLAN_ATTACK, State.PLAY_ATTACKS]
295	
296	
297	func _set_paused(p: bool) -> void:
298		paused = p
299		audio.set_paused(p)
300	
301	
302	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- session
303	
304	func _start_play() -> void:
305		rules.reset()
306		event_log.clear()
307		played_events.clear()
308		_build_pieces()
309		_begin_plan_move()
310	
311	
312	## Retry (R) or play again (Enter on results): full reset to turn 1, music from the top.
313	func _restart(is_retry: bool) -> void:
314		if is_retry:
315			retries += 1
316		else:
317			retries = 0
318		_clear_cues()
319		_arrows.clear()
320		_floaters.clear()
321		_set_paused(false)
322		show_results = false
323		has_marked_target = false
324		_message_left = 0.0
325		last_result = {}
326		rules.reset()
327		event_log.clear()
328		played_events.clear()
329		_build_pieces()
330		for p: PieceScript in pieces.values():
331			p.show_recover()
332		audio.new_session()
333		_begin_plan_move()
334	
335	
336	func _build_pieces() -> void:
337		for p: Node in _pieces_root.get_children():
338			p.queue_free()
339			_pieces_root.remove_child(p)
340		pieces.clear()
341		display_hp.clear()
342		var cells: Dictionary = {}
343		for u: Dictionary in rules.units:
344			cells[u["id"]] = RulesScript.cell_of(u)
345		for u: Dictionary in rules.units:
346			var p: PieceScript = PieceScript.new()
347			p.name = String(u["id"])
348			_pieces_root.add_child(p)
349			p.setup(u["id"], u["team"], int(u["facing"]), RulesScript.cell_of(u))
350			p.position = _slot_pos(u["id"], cells)
351			pieces[u["id"]] = p
352			display_hp[u["id"]] = int(u["hp"])
353	
354	
355	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- move phase
356	
357	func _begin_plan_move() -> void:
358		state = State.PLAN_MOVE
359		planned_offset = Vector2i.ZERO
360		legal_cells = rules.legal_moves(PLAYER_ID)

1	extends SceneTree
2	## A7 Step 2 behaviour pins (CHANGE-BRIEF §8 "pins"): what the game does today, before any clip is wired.
3	## ./scripts/run-test.sh test_pins_a7.gd 60
4	##
5	## Drives main.tscn through the real game loop with real key presses sent through
6	## Input.parse_input_event (the A7 default). Such an event reaches main._unhandled_input one frame
7	## later (CLAUDE.md "Headless facts"), so every key is followed by frame waits. A Sampler node with
8	## process_priority 1000 records one row per frame, after main (0) and the A6 drivers (10).
9	##
10	## Run 1 ("win"): title -> win route (tests/fixtures/win_route.json) -> WON. Pins the state order,
11	##   each archer's pose order, and the three shots' timings: arrow, impact and back-to-idle frames
12	##   after the draw frame (nominal 12 / 33 / 48 at 60 fps, CHANGE-BRIEF §4), and the _arrows window.
13	## Run 2 ("interrupts"): R, the win route's turns 1-3, then turn 4 with Enter during the first
14	##   shot's startup (ignored), P held for 30 frames during its active phase, and R during the
15	##   second shot's active phase.
16	##
17	## The expected values are today's behaviour, measured with this test before any A7 change. The
18	## brief predicts that none of them changes when the clips are wired (CHANGE-BRIEF §8).
19	
20	const Report = preload("res://tests/test_report.gd")
21	const Runner = preload("res://tests/route_runner.gd")
22	const RulesScript = preload("res://game/rules.gd")
23	const MainScene = preload("res://game/main.tscn")
24	
25	const MAX_FRAMES: int = 20000
26	const PAUSE_FRAMES: int = 30
27	
28	## Pinned: main.state with consecutive repeats collapsed, run 1 (title -> WON). Turns 1-3 have no
29	## target in range, so they skip PLAN_ATTACK (measured).
30	const STATE_ORDER: Array[String] = ["TITLE",
31		"PLAN_MOVE", "PLAY_MOVES", "PLAY_ATTACKS",
32		"PLAN_MOVE", "PLAY_MOVES", "PLAY_ATTACKS",
33		"PLAN_MOVE", "PLAY_MOVES", "PLAY_ATTACKS",
34		"PLAN_MOVE", "PLAY_MOVES", "PLAN_ATTACK", "PLAY_ATTACKS",
35		"PLAN_MOVE", "PLAY_MOVES", "PLAN_ATTACK", "PLAY_ATTACKS", "WON"]
36	## Pinned: each archer's pose with consecutive repeats collapsed, run 1 (from the title). There is no
37	## hop image, so a hop shows idle (piece.gd:16, OPTIONAL_FALLBACK) and "hop" never appears (measured).
38	const P1_POSES: Array[String] = ["idle", "hurt", "draw", "idle", "draw", "idle", "win"]
39	const E1_POSES: Array[String] = ["idle", "draw", "idle", "hurt", "idle", "defeat"]
40	## Pinned: per shot in run 1, game frames after the draw frame: [unit, arrow, impact, idle, arrow_end].
41	## arrow_end = the first frame with _arrows empty again. Nominal 12 / 33 / 48 (CHANGE-BRIEF §4); the
42	## cue list fires each cue on the first frame its time is reached on the summed 1/60 s clock, so the
43	## impact and idle cues land one frame early or late (measured; the brief's revision records it).
44	const SHOTS: Array = [
45		["e1", 12, 32, 47, 32],
46		["p1", 12, 34, 49, 32],
47		["p1", 12, 32, 47, 32],
48	]
49	## Pinned: turn 4's two shots start this many frames apart (nominal 63 = 1.05 s).
50	const TURN4_GAP: int = 62
51	## Frames to wait on WON before Enter is accepted (CARD_LOCK 0.5 s, main.gd:37, :283).
52	const CARD_WAIT: int = 45
53	
54	
55	## Records one row per frame, after every other _process() of that frame.
56	class Sampler extends Node:
57		var row_fn: Callable
58		var rows: Array[Dictionary] = []
59	
60		func _process(delta: float) -> void:
61			if row_fn.is_valid():
62				rows.append(row_fn.call(delta))
63	
64	
65	var rep: Report
66	var main: Variant
67	var sampler: Sampler
68	var phase: String = "load"
69	
70	
71	func _initialize() -> void:
72		_run()
73	
74	
75	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
76	
77	## One key press and release through Input.parse_input_event, then two frames so main has read it.
78	func _key(code: int) -> void:
79		for pressed: bool in [true, false]:
80			var ev: InputEventKey = InputEventKey.new()
81			ev.keycode = code as Key
82			ev.physical_keycode = code as Key
83			ev.pressed = pressed
84			Input.parse_input_event(ev)
85		await _frames(2)
86	
87	
88	func _s() -> String:
89		return main.state_name()
90	
91	
92	func _frames(n: int) -> void:
93		for i: int in n:
94			await process_frame
95	
96	
97	func _wait(cond: Callable) -> bool:
98		for i: int in MAX_FRAMES:
99			if cond.call():
100				return true
101			await process_frame
102		return false
103	
104	
105	func _pose(id: String) -> String:
106		var p: Variant = main.pieces.get(id)
107		return String(p.state) if p != null else ""
108	
109	
110	func _damaged_played() -> int:
111		var n: int = 0
112		for ev: Dictionary in main.played_events:
113			if ev["type"] == "damaged":
114				n += 1
115		return n
116	
117	
118	func _row(delta: float) -> Dictionary:
119		var p1: Variant = main.pieces.get("p1")
120		var e1: Variant = main.pieces.get("e1")
121		return {"i": sampler.rows.size(), "phase": phase, "state": _s(), "p1": _pose("p1"), "e1": _pose("e1"),
122			"p1_id": p1.get_instance_id() if p1 != null else 0, "e1_id": e1.get_instance_id() if e1 != null else 0,
123			"arrows": main._arrows.size(), "ignored": int(main.ignored_inputs), "paused": bool(main.paused),
124			"turn": int(main.rules.turn), "damaged": _damaged_played(), "delta": delta}
125	
126	
127	static func _collapse(seq: Array) -> Array:
128		var out: Array = []
129		for v: Variant in seq:
130			if out.is_empty() or out[-1] != v:
131				out.append(v)
132		return out
133	
134	
135	func _rows_of(ph: String) -> Array[Dictionary]:
136		var out: Array[Dictionary] = []
137		for r: Dictionary in sampler.rows:
138			if r["phase"] == ph:
139				out.append(r)
140		return out
141	
142	
143	## Every shot in `rows`: the row index where a unit enters "draw", then the first later rows where an
144	## arrow appears, a damaged event is played, the unit leaves "draw", and _arrows is empty again.
145	## Paused rows are skipped, so the offsets count game frames.
146	static func _shots(rows: Array[Dictionary]) -> Array:
147		var out: Array = []
148		for i: int in range(1, rows.size()):
149			for id: String in ["e1", "p1"]:
150				if rows[i][id] == "draw" and rows[i - 1][id] != "draw":
151					out.append(_measure(rows, i, id))
152		out.sort_custom(func(a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary) -> bool: return a["start"] < b["start"])
153		return out
154	
155	
156	static func _measure(rows: Array[Dictionary], start: int, id: String) -> Dictionary:
157		var m: Dictionary = {"unit": id, "start": start, "arrow": -1, "impact": -1, "idle": -1, "arrow_end": -1,
158			"paused_frames": 0}
159		var game: int = 0
160		for j: int in range(start + 1, rows.size()):
161			if rows[j]["paused"]:
162				m["paused_frames"] += 1
163				continue
164			game += 1
165			if m["arrow"] < 0 and rows[j]["arrows"] > rows[j - 1]["arrows"]:
166				m["arrow"] = game
167			if m["arrow"] >= 0 and m["arrow_end"] < 0 and rows[j]["arrows"] == 0:
168				m["arrow_end"] = game
169			if m["impact"] < 0 and rows[j]["damaged"] > rows[j - 1]["damaged"]:
170				m["impact"] = game
171			if rows[j][id] != "draw":
172				m["idle"] = game
173				m["left_to"] = rows[j][id]
174				break
175		return m
176	
177	
178	func _route_turn(step: Dictionary, label: String) -> bool:
179		if not await _wait(func() -> bool: return _s() == "PLAN_MOVE"):
180			rep.check("%s: reached PLAN_MOVE" % label, false, _s())
181			return false
182		var turn_no: int = main.rules.turn
183		var mv: Vector2i = Runner.move_of(step)
184		if mv == Vector2i.ZERO:
185			await _key(KEY_SPACE)
186		else:
187			if mv.x == 1:
188				await _key(KEY_RIGHT)
189			elif mv.x == -1:
190				await _key(KEY_LEFT)
191			if mv.y == -1:
192				await _key(KEY_UP)
193			elif mv.y == 1:
194				await _key(KEY_DOWN)
195			await _key(KEY_ENTER)
196		var after_moves: Callable = func() -> bool:
197			var s: String = _s()
198			return s == "PLAN_ATTACK" or s == "PLAY_ATTACKS" or s == "WON" or s == "LOST" \
199				or (s == "PLAN_MOVE" and main.rules.turn > turn_no)
200		if not await _wait(after_moves):
201			rep.check("%s: move playback finished" % label, false, _s())
202			return false
203		var t: Variant = Runner.target_of(step)
204		if _s() == "PLAN_ATTACK":
205			if t == null:
206				await _key(KEY_SPACE)
207			else:
208				var n: int = 0
209				while main.selected_target() != t and n < 30:
210					await _key(KEY_RIGHT)
211					n += 1
212				if main.selected_target() != t:
213					rep.check("%s: target %s selectable" % [label, t], false, main.targets)
214					return false
215				await _key(KEY_ENTER)
216		elif t != null:
217			rep.check("%s: the route's target %s could be ordered" % [label, t], false, _s())
218			return false
219		return true
220	
221	
222	func _turn_done(turn_no: int) -> bool:
223		var s: String = _s()
224		return s == "WON" or s == "LOST" or (s == "PLAN_MOVE" and main.rules.turn > turn_no)
225	
226	
227	func _play_turn(step: Dictionary, label: String) -> bool:
228		var turn_no: int = main.rules.turn
229		if not await _route_turn(step, label):
230			return false
231		if not await _wait(_turn_done.bind(turn_no)):
232			rep.check("%s: attack playback finished" % label, false, _s())
233			return false
234		return true
235	
236	
237	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- run
238	
239	func _run() -> void:
240		rep = Report.new("test_pins_a7")
241		await process_frame
242		main = MainScene.instantiate()
243		root.add_child(main)
244		sampler = Sampler.new()
245		sampler.name = "Sampler"
246		sampler.process_priority = 1000
247		root.add_child(sampler)
248		sampler.row_fn = _row
249	
250		var win: Dictionary = Runner.load_route("res://tests/fixtures/win_route.json")
251		var turns: Array = win["turns"]
252	
253		# ---------------------------------------------------- run 1: title -> win route -> WON
254		phase = "win"
255		await _frames(10)
256		await _key(KEY_ENTER)
257		rep.check("Enter on the title (parse_input_event) starts turn 1 in PLAN_MOVE", _s() == "PLAN_MOVE"
258			and main.rules.turn == 1, "%s, turn %d" % [_s(), main.rules.turn])
259		for i: int in turns.size():
260			if not await _play_turn(turns[i], "win turn %d" % (i + 1)):
261				quit(rep.finish())
262				return
263		await _frames(10)
264		rep.check("run 1 ends in WON (elimination)", _s() == "WON" and String(main.last_result.get("kind", "")) == "elimination",
265			"%s %s" % [_s(), main.last_result])
266	
267		var r1: Array[Dictionary] = _rows_of("win")
268		var odd: Array = r1.filter(func(r: Dictionary) -> bool: return not is_equal_approx(float(r["delta"]), 1.0 / 60.0))
269		rep.check("fixed frame rate: every sampled delta is 1/60 s (%d frames; run at 60)" % r1.size(), odd.is_empty(),
270			"%d other deltas" % odd.size())
271		var states: Array = _collapse(r1.map(func(r: Dictionary) -> String: return r["state"]))
272		rep.check("pin: main.state order, title to WON (%d states)" % STATE_ORDER.size(), states == Array(STATE_ORDER), states)
273		var p1p: Array = _collapse(r1.map(func(r: Dictionary) -> String: return r["p1"]))
274		var e1p: Array = _collapse(r1.map(func(r: Dictionary) -> String: return r["e1"]))
275		rep.check("pin: p1 pose order", p1p == Array(P1_POSES), p1p)
276		rep.check("pin: e1 pose order", e1p == Array(E1_POSES), e1p)

extends SceneTree
## A7 Step 2 behaviour pins (CHANGE-BRIEF §8 "pins"): what the game does today, before any clip is wired.
## ./scripts/run-test.sh test_pins_a7.gd 60
##
## Drives main.tscn through the real game loop with real key presses sent through
## Input.parse_input_event (the A7 default). Such an event reaches main._unhandled_input one frame
## later (CLAUDE.md "Headless facts"), so every key is followed by frame waits. A Sampler node with
## process_priority 1000 records one row per frame, after main (0) and the A6 drivers (10).
##
## Run 1 ("win"): title -> win route (tests/fixtures/win_route.json) -> WON. Pins the state order,
##   each archer's pose order, and the three shots' timings: arrow, impact and back-to-idle frames
##   after the draw frame (nominal 12 / 33 / 48 at 60 fps, CHANGE-BRIEF §4), and the _arrows window.
## Run 2 ("interrupts"): R, the win route's turns 1-3, then turn 4 with Enter during the first
##   shot's startup (ignored), P held for 30 frames during its active phase, and R during the
##   second shot's active phase.
##
## The expected values are today's behaviour, measured with this test before any A7 change. The
## brief predicts that none of them changes when the clips are wired (CHANGE-BRIEF §8).

const Report = preload("res://tests/test_report.gd")
const Runner = preload("res://tests/route_runner.gd")
const RulesScript = preload("res://game/rules.gd")
const MainScene = preload("res://game/main.tscn")

const MAX_FRAMES: int = 20000
const PAUSE_FRAMES: int = 30

## Pinned: main.state with consecutive repeats collapsed, run 1 (title -> WON). Turns 1-3 have no
## target in range, so they skip PLAN_ATTACK (measured).
const STATE_ORDER: Array[String] = ["TITLE",
	"PLAN_MOVE", "PLAY_MOVES", "PLAY_ATTACKS",
	"PLAN_MOVE", "PLAY_MOVES", "PLAY_ATTACKS",
	"PLAN_MOVE", "PLAY_MOVES", "PLAY_ATTACKS",
	"PLAN_MOVE", "PLAY_MOVES", "PLAN_ATTACK", "PLAY_ATTACKS",
	"PLAN_MOVE", "PLAY_MOVES", "PLAN_ATTACK", "PLAY_ATTACKS", "WON"]
## Pinned: each archer's pose with consecutive repeats collapsed, run 1 (from the title). There is no
## hop image, so a hop shows idle (piece.gd:16, OPTIONAL_FALLBACK) and "hop" never appears (measured).
const P1_POSES: Array[String] = ["idle", "hurt", "draw", "idle", "draw", "idle", "win"]
const E1_POSES: Array[String] = ["idle", "draw", "idle", "hurt", "idle", "defeat"]
## Pinned: per shot in run 1, game frames after the draw frame: [unit, arrow, impact, idle, arrow_end].
## arrow_end = the first frame with _arrows empty again. Nominal 12 / 33 / 48 (CHANGE-BRIEF §4); the
## cue list fires each cue on the first frame its time is reached on the summed 1/60 s clock, so the
## impact and idle cues land one frame early or late (measured; the brief's revision records it).
const SHOTS: Array = [
	["e1", 12, 32, 47, 32],
	["p1", 12, 34, 49, 32],
	["p1", 12, 32, 47, 32],
]
## Pinned: turn 4's two shots start this many frames apart (nominal 63 = 1.05 s).
const TURN4_GAP: int = 62
## Frames to wait on WON before Enter is accepted (CARD_LOCK 0.5 s, main.gd:37, :283).
const CARD_WAIT: int = 45


## Records one row per frame, after every other _process() of that frame.
class Sampler extends Node:
	var row_fn: Callable
	var rows: Array[Dictionary] = []

	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		if row_fn.is_valid():
			rows.append(row_fn.call(delta))


var rep: Report
var main: Variant
var sampler: Sampler
var phase: String = "load"


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

## One key press and release through Input.parse_input_event, then two frames so main has read it.
func _key(code: int) -> void:
	for pressed: bool in [true, false]:
		var ev: InputEventKey = InputEventKey.new()
		ev.keycode = code as Key
		ev.physical_keycode = code as Key
		ev.pressed = pressed
		Input.parse_input_event(ev)
	await _frames(2)


func _s() -> String:
	return main.state_name()


func _frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i: int in n:
		await process_frame


func _wait(cond: Callable) -> bool:
	for i: int in MAX_FRAMES:
		if cond.call():
			return true
		await process_frame
	return false


func _pose(id: String) -> String:
	var p: Variant = main.pieces.get(id)
	return String(p.state) if p != null else ""


func _damaged_played() -> int:
	var n: int = 0
	for ev: Dictionary in main.played_events:
		if ev["type"] == "damaged":
			n += 1
	return n


func _row(delta: float) -> Dictionary:
	var p1: Variant = main.pieces.get("p1")
	var e1: Variant = main.pieces.get("e1")
	return {"i": sampler.rows.size(), "phase": phase, "state": _s(), "p1": _pose("p1"), "e1": _pose("e1"),
		"p1_id": p1.get_instance_id() if p1 != null else 0, "e1_id": e1.get_instance_id() if e1 != null else 0,
		"arrows": main._arrows.size(), "ignored": int(main.ignored_inputs), "paused": bool(main.paused),
		"turn": int(main.rules.turn), "damaged": _damaged_played(), "delta": delta}


static func _collapse(seq: Array) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	for v: Variant in seq:
		if out.is_empty() or out[-1] != v:
			out.append(v)
	return out


func _rows_of(ph: String) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var out: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for r: Dictionary in sampler.rows:
		if r["phase"] == ph:
			out.append(r)
	return out


## Every shot in `rows`: the row index where a unit enters "draw", then the first later rows where an
## arrow appears, a damaged event is played, the unit leaves "draw", and _arrows is empty again.
## Paused rows are skipped, so the offsets count game frames.
static func _shots(rows: Array[Dictionary]) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	for i: int in range(1, rows.size()):
		for id: String in ["e1", "p1"]:
			if rows[i][id] == "draw" and rows[i - 1][id] != "draw":
				out.append(_measure(rows, i, id))
	out.sort_custom(func(a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary) -> bool: return a["start"] < b["start"])
	return out


static func _measure(rows: Array[Dictionary], start: int, id: String) -> Dictionary:
	var m: Dictionary = {"unit": id, "start": start, "arrow": -1, "impact": -1, "idle": -1, "arrow_end": -1,
		"paused_frames": 0}
	var game: int = 0
	for j: int in range(start + 1, rows.size()):
		if rows[j]["paused"]:
			m["paused_frames"] += 1
			continue
		game += 1
		if m["arrow"] < 0 and rows[j]["arrows"] > rows[j - 1]["arrows"]:
			m["arrow"] = game
		if m["arrow"] >= 0 and m["arrow_end"] < 0 and rows[j]["arrows"] == 0:
			m["arrow_end"] = game
		if m["impact"] < 0 and rows[j]["damaged"] > rows[j - 1]["damaged"]:
			m["impact"] = game
		if rows[j][id] != "draw":
			m["idle"] = game
			m["left_to"] = rows[j][id]
			break
	return m


func _route_turn(step: Dictionary, label: String) -> bool:
	if not await _wait(func() -> bool: return _s() == "PLAN_MOVE"):
		rep.check("%s: reached PLAN_MOVE" % label, false, _s())
		return false
	var turn_no: int = main.rules.turn
	var mv: Vector2i = Runner.move_of(step)
	if mv == Vector2i.ZERO:
		await _key(KEY_SPACE)
	else:
		if mv.x == 1:
			await _key(KEY_RIGHT)
		elif mv.x == -1:
			await _key(KEY_LEFT)
		if mv.y == -1:
			await _key(KEY_UP)
		elif mv.y == 1:
			await _key(KEY_DOWN)
		await _key(KEY_ENTER)
	var after_moves: Callable = func() -> bool:
		var s: String = _s()
		return s == "PLAN_ATTACK" or s == "PLAY_ATTACKS" or s == "WON" or s == "LOST" \
			or (s == "PLAN_MOVE" and main.rules.turn > turn_no)
	if not await _wait(after_moves):
		rep.check("%s: move playback finished" % label, false, _s())
		return false
	var t: Variant = Runner.target_of(step)
	if _s() == "PLAN_ATTACK":
		if t == null:
			await _key(KEY_SPACE)
		else:
			var n: int = 0
			while main.selected_target() != t and n < 30:
				await _key(KEY_RIGHT)
				n += 1
			if main.selected_target() != t:
				rep.check("%s: target %s selectable" % [label, t], false, main.targets)
				return false
			await _key(KEY_ENTER)
	elif t != null:
		rep.check("%s: the route's target %s could be ordered" % [label, t], false, _s())
		return false
	return true


func _turn_done(turn_no: int) -> bool:
	var s: String = _s()
	return s == "WON" or s == "LOST" or (s == "PLAN_MOVE" and main.rules.turn > turn_no)


func _play_turn(step: Dictionary, label: String) -> bool:
	var turn_no: int = main.rules.turn
	if not await _route_turn(step, label):
		return false
	if not await _wait(_turn_done.bind(turn_no)):
		rep.check("%s: attack playback finished" % label, false, _s())
		return false
	return true


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- run

func _run() -> void:
	rep = Report.new("test_pins_a7")
	await process_frame
	main = MainScene.instantiate()
	root.add_child(main)
	sampler = Sampler.new()
	sampler.name = "Sampler"
	sampler.process_priority = 1000
	root.add_child(sampler)
	sampler.row_fn = _row

	var win: Dictionary = Runner.load_route("res://tests/fixtures/win_route.json")
	var turns: Array = win["turns"]

	# ---------------------------------------------------- run 1: title -> win route -> WON
	phase = "win"
	await _frames(10)
	await _key(KEY_ENTER)
	rep.check("Enter on the title (parse_input_event) starts turn 1 in PLAN_MOVE", _s() == "PLAN_MOVE"
		and main.rules.turn == 1, "%s, turn %d" % [_s(), main.rules.turn])
	for i: int in turns.size():
		if not await _play_turn(turns[i], "win turn %d" % (i + 1)):
			quit(rep.finish())
			return
	await _frames(10)
	rep.check("run 1 ends in WON (elimination)", _s() == "WON" and String(main.last_result.get("kind", "")) == "elimination",
		"%s %s" % [_s(), main.last_result])

	var r1: Array[Dictionary] = _rows_of("win")
	var odd: Array = r1.filter(func(r: Dictionary) -> bool: return not is_equal_approx(float(r["delta"]), 1.0 / 60.0))
	rep.check("fixed frame rate: every sampled delta is 1/60 s (%d frames; run at 60)" % r1.size(), odd.is_empty(),
		"%d other deltas" % odd.size())
	var states: Array = _collapse(r1.map(func(r: Dictionary) -> String: return r["state"]))
	rep.check("pin: main.state order, title to WON (%d states)" % STATE_ORDER.size(), states == Array(STATE_ORDER), states)
	var p1p: Array = _collapse(r1.map(func(r: Dictionary) -> String: return r["p1"]))
	var e1p: Array = _collapse(r1.map(func(r: Dictionary) -> String: return r["e1"]))
	rep.check("pin: p1 pose order", p1p == Array(P1_POSES), p1p)
	rep.check("pin: e1 pose order", e1p == Array(E1_POSES), e1p)

	var shots: Array = _shots(r1)
	rep.check("pin: run 1 has %d shots, in order %s" % [SHOTS.size(), SHOTS.map(func(s: Array) -> String: return s[0])],
		shots.size() == SHOTS.size() and shots.map(func(s: Dictionary) -> String: return s["unit"]) == SHOTS.map(func(s: Array) -> String: return s[0]),
		shots)
	for k: int in mini(shots.size(), SHOTS.size()):
		var s: Dictionary = shots[k]
		var e: Array = SHOTS[k]
		var label: String = "shot %d (%s, draw on row %d)" % [k + 1, s["unit"], s["start"]]
		rep.check("pin: %s: arrow appears %d frames after the draw (startup)" % [label, e[1]], s["arrow"] == e[1], s["arrow"])
		rep.check("pin: %s: impact %d frames after the draw (startup + active)" % [label, e[2]], s["impact"] == e[2], s["impact"])
		rep.check("pin: %s: back to idle %d frames after the draw (startup + active + recovery)" % [label, e[3]],
			s["idle"] == e[3] and s.get("left_to", "") == "idle", "%d -> %s" % [s["idle"], s.get("left_to", "")])
		rep.check("pin: %s: _arrows empty again %d frames after the draw (0-2 frames before the impact)" % [label, e[4]],
			s["arrow_end"] == e[4] and s["impact"] - s["arrow_end"] >= 0 and s["impact"] - s["arrow_end"] <= 2, s["arrow_end"])
	if shots.size() >= 2:
		rep.check("pin: turn 4's two shots start %d frames apart (nominal 63 = 1.05 s)" % TURN4_GAP,
			shots[1]["start"] - shots[0]["start"] == TURN4_GAP, shots[1]["start"] - shots[0]["start"])
	var ign1: int = r1[-1]["ignored"]
	rep.check("pin: run 1 ignored no input (every key was legal where it was pressed)", ign1 == 0, ign1)

	# ---------------------------------------------------- run 2: interrupts during turn 4's shots
	phase = "interrupts"
	await _frames(CARD_WAIT)
	await _key(KEY_ENTER) # results card
	await _key(KEY_ENTER) # play again -> turn 1
	rep.check("Enter, Enter on WON: play again, turn 1 in PLAN_MOVE", _s() == "PLAN_MOVE" and main.rules.turn == 1,
		"%s, turn %d" % [_s(), main.rules.turn])
	for i: int in 3:
		if not await _play_turn(turns[i], "interrupts turn %d" % (i + 1)):
			quit(rep.finish())
			return
	if not await _route_turn(turns[3], "interrupts turn 4"):
		quit(rep.finish())
		return
	# First shot (e1): Enter during startup, then P for PAUSE_FRAMES during the active phase.
	if not await _wait(func() -> bool: return _pose("e1") == "draw"):
		rep.check("turn 4: e1 draws", false, _pose("e1"))
		quit(rep.finish())
		return
	var ign0: int = main.ignored_inputs
	await _key(KEY_ENTER)
	rep.check("pin: Enter during the startup is ignored (ignored_inputs + 1, still PLAY_ATTACKS, e1 still draw)",
		main.ignored_inputs == ign0 + 1 and _s() == "PLAY_ATTACKS" and _pose("e1") == "draw",
		"%d -> %d, %s, %s" % [ign0, main.ignored_inputs, _s(), _pose("e1")])
	await _wait(func() -> bool: return main._arrows.size() > 0)
	await _frames(5)
	var clock0: float = main._clock
	var arrow_t0: float = float(main._arrows[0]["t"]) if main._arrows.size() > 0 else -1.0
	await _key(KEY_P)
	var paused_from: float = main._clock
	await _frames(PAUSE_FRAMES)
	rep.check("pin: P in the active phase pauses: game clock, arrow t and e1's pose hold for %d frames" % PAUSE_FRAMES,
		main.paused and is_equal_approx(main._clock, paused_from) and _pose("e1") == "draw" and main._arrows.size() == 1,
		"paused %s, clock %.4f -> %.4f, pose %s, arrows %d" % [main.paused, paused_from, main._clock, _pose("e1"), main._arrows.size()])
	await _key(KEY_P)
	rep.check("pin: P again resumes (paused false, clock moves)", not main.paused and main._clock > paused_from,
		"clock %.4f -> %.4f (arrow t was %.4f at %.4f)" % [paused_from, main._clock, arrow_t0, clock0])
	# Second shot (p1): R during its active phase.
	if not await _wait(func() -> bool: return _pose("p1") == "draw"):
		rep.check("turn 4: p1 draws", false, _pose("p1"))
		quit(rep.finish())
		return
	await _wait(func() -> bool: return main._arrows.size() > 0)
	await _frames(5)
	var old_p1: int = main.pieces["p1"].get_instance_id()
	var retries0: int = main.retries
	await _key(KEY_R)
	rep.check("pin: R in the active phase restarts: turn 1, PLAN_MOVE, _arrows empty, retries + 1",

		main.pieces["p1"].get_instance_id() != old_p1 and _pose("p1") in ["recover", "idle"],
